items.source: This differs from DelegatingIntroductionInterceptor in that a single instance of this class can be used to advise multiple target objects, and each target object will have its own delegate (whereas DelegatingIntroductionInterceptor shares the same delegate, and hence the same state across all targets).
items.translation: 这与DelegatingIntroductionInterceptor不同，因为该类的一个实例可用于为多个目标对象提供建议（advise），且每个目标对象都拥有其自己的委托对象（而 DelegatingIntroductionInterceptor 共享同一个委托对象，因此所有目标对象的状态是相同的）。

items.source: Note: There are some implementation similarities between this class and DelegatingIntroductionInterceptor that suggest a possible refactoring to extract a common ancestor class in the future.
items.translation: 注意：此类与DelegatingIntroductionInterceptor之间存在一些实现上的相似之处，这表明未来可能会重构以提取一个公共的祖先类。

items.source: The suppressInterface method can be used to suppress interfaces implemented by the delegate class but which should not be introduced to the owning AOP proxy.
items.translation: suppressInterface 方法可用于抑制由代理类实现但不应引入到所属 AOP 代理的接口。

items.source: An instance of this class is serializable if the delegates are.
items.translation: 如果委托是可序列化的，则此类的实例也是可序列化的。

items.source: Proceed with the supplied MethodInterceptor. Subclasses can override this method to intercept method invocations on the target object which is useful when an introduction needs to monitor the object that it is introduced into. This method is never called for MethodInvocations on the introduced interfaces.
items.translation: 继续提供已供应的 MethodInterceptor。子类可以重写此方法来拦截对目标对象的 method 调用，这在需要监控被引入对象时非常有用。此方法永远不会针对引入接口上的 MethodInvocations 被调用。

items.source: Proceed with the supplied MethodInterceptor.

Subclasses may need to override this if they want to perform custom
behaviour in around advice. However, subclasses should invoke this
method, which handles introduced interfaces and forwarding to the target.
items.translation: 子类如果希望在环绕建议（around advice）中执行自定义行为，可能需要重写此方法。然而，子类应调用此方法，该方法负责处理引入的接口并转发到目标。

items.source:
Subclasses may need to override this if they want to perform custom

items.translation: 子类如果希望在环绕通知中执行自定义行为，可能需要重写此方法。
`invoke` 在接口 `MethodInterceptor` 中

items.source: the result of the call to Joinpoint.proceed(); might be intercepted by the interceptor
items.translation: 调用Joinpoint.proceed()的结果；可能会被拦截器拦截。

items.source: Throwable - if the interceptors or the target object throws an exception
items.translation: Throwable - 如果拦截器或目标对象抛出异常
